title: Decision: State counter pattern for efficient change tracking
description: All three stores (contact, chat, message) maintain a state_counters table with monotonic counters (lines 82-85 in lib.rs, initialized to 0, never reset). Each write operation advances its type's counter and returns the new state as 's-N'. This enables efficient get_changes_since queries that compare counter values instead of scanning timestamps. The counter is authoritative for change detection. Rejected alternative: timestamp-based tracking would lose precision and require careful clock handling.
